4.3.1.v: The affix खञ् also comes optionally in the remaining senses after the words 1. युष्मद् and 2. अस्मद्।

4.3.2.v: When the affix खञ् is added and when अण् is added then 1. युष्माक and 2. अस्माक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

4.3.3.v: In expressing one individual, तबक and ममक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद् respectively when खञ् and अण् follow.

4.3.4.v: The affix यत् comes after the word अर्द्ध in the remaining senses.

4.3.5.v: The affix यत् comes in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध when preceded by 1. पर 2. अवर 3. अधम and 4. उत्तम।

4.3.6.v: And the affix ठञ् also (as well as यत्) comes in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध when the prior term denotes a direction.

4.3.7.v: The affixes अञ् and ठञ् come in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध preceded by a word denoting direction when a particular portion of a village or an inhabited country.

4.3.8.v: After the word मध्य there is the affix म in the remaining senses.

4.3.9.v: The affix अ comes in the remaining senses after the word मध्य , the meaning being 'fit' or 'proper'.

4.3.10.v: The affix यञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word द्वीप , which is near the sea.

4.3.11.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the words denoting time.

4.3.12.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word शरद् when expressing श्राद्ध।

4.3.13.v: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word शरद् when expressing illness or heat.

4.3.14.v: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the words 1. निशा and 2. प्रदोष ।

4.3.15.v: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word श्वस् and it takes the augment तुट्।

4.3.16.v: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after the words संधिवेला etc. and the words expressing 'season' and 'asterism'.

4.3.17.v: The affix एण्य comes in the remaining senses after the word प्रावृष।

4.3.18.v: The affix ठक् comes in the remaining senses after the word वर्षा।

4.3.19.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the word वर्षा takes the affix ठञ् , in the remaining senses.

4.3.20.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word वसन्त।

4.3.21.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word हेमन्त।

4.3.22.v: The affix अण् comes always after the word हेमन्त and (before this affix) the letter त of हेमन्त is elided.

4.3.23.v: After the words 1. सायं 'at eve' 2. चिरम् 'for a long time' 3. प्राह्णे 'in the forenoon' 4. प्रगे 'at dawn' and after indeclinables expressing time, there are the affixes ट्यु and ट्युल् and their augment is तुट्।
4.3.23.e: The words सायम्, चिरम्, प्रगे, प्राह्णे, and all the कालवाचक-अव्ययानि get the ट्यु and ट्युल् प्रत्यय in the शैषिक-meanings. Also, the ट्यु and ट्युल् प्रत्यय get a तुट् आगम in this context.
4.3.23.sa: प्राग्दीव्यतीयेषु शैषिकेषु अर्थेषु सायम्, चिरम्, प्राह्णे, प्रगे - एतेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः तथा कालवाचिभ्यः अव्ययेभ्यः ट्यु/ट्युलौ प्रत्ययौ, तथा प्रत्ययस्य तुट्-आगमः भवति ।
4.3.23.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.3.24.v: Optionally after the words 1. पूर्वाह्ण and 2. अपराह्ण there are the affixes ट्यु and ट्युल् and their augment is तुट्।

4.3.25.v: The affixes ordained above or hereafter come after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'born or grown or originated there or then'.

4.3.26.v: After the word प्रावृट् being in the Locative -7th case-affix, there is the affix ठप् in the sense of 'produced therein'.

4.3.27.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the word शरद in the Locative -7th case-affix in the sense of 'born therein', the whole word being a name.

4.3.28.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'born therein' after the words 1. पूर्वाह्ण 2. अपराह्ण 3. आर्द्रा 4. मूला 5. प्रदोष and 6. अवस्कर , the whole being a name.

4.3.29.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the word पथ , in the sense of 'produced therein' and thereby in the room of पथ , the substitute is पन्थ।

4.3.30.v: The affix वुञ् comes optionally after the word अमावास्या in the sense of 'born therein'.

4.3.31.v: The affix अ is also added to the word अमावास्या in the sense of 'born therein'.

4.3.32.v: After the words 1. सिन्धु and 2. अपकर there is the affix कन् in the sense of 'born therein'.

4.3.33.v: And the affixes अण् and अञ् come respectively after the words 1. सिन्धु and 2. अपकर।

4.3.34.v: The affix denoting 'born therein' is elided by लुक् after the words 1. श्रविष्ठ 2. फाल्गुनी 3. अनुराधा 4. स्वाति 5. तिष्य 6. पुनर्वसु 7. हस्त 8. विशाखा 9. अषाढा and 10. बहुला , all denoting asterisms.

4.3.35.v: There is लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after a word ending in स्थान and after the words 1. गोशाल and 2. खरशाल।

4.3.36.v: There is optionally लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after the words 1. वत्सशाला 2. अभिजित् 3. अश्वयुक् and 4. शतभित्।

4.3.37.v: There is diversely लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after an asterism.

4.3.38.v: An affix (one of those already taught) comes after a word in the Locative -7th case, in the sense of 'done there', 'obtained there', 'bought there' and 'dexterous therein'.

4.3.39.v: After a word being in construction in the Locative -7th case, an affix (one of those ordained already) comes in the sense of 'generally found therein'.

4.3.40.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'mostly to be found there' after the words 1. उपजानु 2. उपकरण and 3. उपोनीवि , being in the Locative -7th case.

4.3.41.v: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) or a word ending in the feminine affix ङि and आप् , being in the Locative -7th case in construction, an affix comes in the sense of 'adapted therein'.

4.3.42.v: The affix ढञ् comes after the words कोश etc. in the sense of 'adapted to that'.

4.3.43.v: An affix comes after a word denoting time being in the Locative -7th case in construction, in the sense of 'being good', 'flowering' or 'ripening therein.

4.3.44.v: An affix comes after a word denoting 'time' being in the Locative -7th case in construction meaning 'sown therein'.

4.3.45.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'sown' after the word आश्वयुजी।

4.3.46.v: The affix वुञ् comes optionally after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. वसन्त in the sense of 'sown'.

4.3.47.v: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) being in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting time, an affix comes in the sense of 'being then due'; provided that the thing due be 'debt'.

4.3.48.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'debt then due' after the words 1. कलापिन् 2. अश्वत्थ and 3. यवबुस् , denoting time and being in the Locative -7th case.

4.3.49.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'debt due' after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. अवरसम।

4.3.50.v: The affix ठञ् also (as well as वुञ् ) comes after the words 1. संवत्सरा 2. अग्राहायणी in the sense of 'debt due'.

4.3.51.v: An affix comes after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting time, in the sense of 'who then wanders' and the word so formed refers to a wild beast.

4.3.52.v: An affix comes after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction denoting time in the sense of 'this is his habit or endurance'.

4.3.53.v: An affix comes after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.54.v: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'who stays there' after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) दिक् etc.

4.3.55.v: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after a word denoting a part of the body.

4.3.56.v: The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after the words 1. दृति 2. कुक्षि 3. कलशि 4. वस्ति 5. अस्ति and 6. अहि।

4.3.57.v: The affix अण् also (as well as ढञ् ) comes after the word ग्रीवा in the sense of 'what stays there'.

4.3.58.v: The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'who stays there' after the word गम्भीर।

4.3.59.v: After an अव्ययीभाव समास the affix ञ्य is used in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.60.v: After an अव्ययीभाव समास having the word अन्तर as prior term, the affix ठञ् is used in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.61.v: After the word ग्राम preceded by परि or अनु (the whole being अव्ययीभाव समास ) there is the affix ठञ् in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.62.v: After the words 1. जिह्वामूल and 2. अङ्गुलि there is the affix छ in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.63.v: After a word ending with वर्ग the affix छ is used in the sense of 'who occurs there'.

4.3.64.v: After a word ending with वर्ग but not meaning a 'letter or word' the affixes यत् and ख are optionally used in the sense of 'who stays there'.

4.3.65.v: The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'what occurs there' after कर्ण and ललाट , the word denoting 'an ornament'.

4.3.66.v: After the name of a subject of commentary an affix comes in the sense of 'its commentary', as well as in the sense of 'what occurs there'.

4.3.67.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'staying' and 'a commentary' after a polysyllabic word having उदात्त on the final (the word being the name of a thing to be explained).

4.3.68.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'occurring' and 'a commentary' after the name of a work to be explained provided that such work relates to a क्रतु or a यज्ञ।

4.3.69.v: The affix ठञ् comes after the name of an explainable work called after a ऋषि in the senses of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' when it refers to an अध्याय only.

4.3.70.v: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' and 'commentary thereon' after the words 1. पौरोडाश and 2. पुरोडाश।

4.3.71.v: The affixes यत् and अण् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' after the word छन्दस्।

4.3.72.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' after a word of two syllables and a word ending in short ऋ and the words 1. ब्राह्मण 2. ऋक् 3. प्रथम 4. पुरश्चरण 5. नाम 6. आख्यात and 7. नामाख्यात being the names of explainable works.

4.3.73.v: The affix अण् comes in the senses of 'occurring therein' and 'commentary thereon' after the words ऋगयन etc.

4.3.74.v: The affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc. comes in the sense of 'what has come thence'.

4.3.75.v: After a word denoting sources of revenue there is the affix ठक् in the sense of 'come thence'.

4.3.76.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'thence come' after the words शुण्डिक etc.

4.3.77.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'thence come' after a word denoting a person connected through the relationship or family origin.

4.3.78.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'come thence' after a word ending in short ऋ and denoting a person related through learning or blood.

4.3.79.v: The affix यत् and ठञ् comes in the sense of 'come thence' after the word पितृ।

4.3.80.v: After a word ending with a Patronymic affix the rule of affix in the sense of 'thence come' is like that relating to the affix denoting its mark.

4.3.81.v: The affix रूप्य denotes that which from something has originated when it is added to a word denoting 'cause' or to the name of a man viewed as a cause.

4.3.82.v: After a word denoting a cause or a man viewed as a cause, there is the affix मयट् in the sense of 'come thence'.

4.3.83.v: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which is the Ablative -5th case in construction, an affix (one of those already taught) comes in the sense of 'what appears for the first time'.

4.3.84.v: The affix य comes in the sense of 'what manifests itself there' after the word विदुर।

4.3.85.v: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc. comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'what goes thereto', provided that, which goes, is a road or a messenger.

4.3.86.v: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc. comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'a door which looks towards that'.

4.3.87.v: An affix comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'made in relation to any subject' when the thing made is a 'book'.

4.3.88.v: The affix छ comes in the sense of 'a book made relating to a subject' after the following words in the Accusative -2nd case in construction viz. 1. शिशुक्रन्द 2. यमसभ , the द्वन्द समास and the words इन्द्रजनन etc.

4.3.89.v: After a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, an affix comes in the sense of 'this is his dwelling place'.

4.3.90.v: After a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, an affix comes in the sense of 'this is his mother-land'.

4.3.91.v: The affix छ comes after a word denoting 'mountain' in the sense of 'this is his mother-land', when it is a person who lives by arms.

4.3.92.v: The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'this is his native-land' after the words शण्डिक etc.

4.3.93.v: The affixes अण् and अञ् come respectively after the words सिन्धु etc. and तक्षशिला etc. in the sense of 'this is his native land'.

4.3.94.v: After the words 1. तूदी 2. शलातुर 3. वर्मती and 4. कूचवार come respectively the affixes 1. ढक् 2. छण् 3. ढञ् and 4. यक् in the sense of 'this is his native land'.

4.3.95.v: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction in the sense of 'this is his object of veneration or love'.

4.3.96.v: After a word denoting a thing not having consciousness, but not being the name of a country or time, the affix ठक् is used in the sense of 'this is his object of devotion or love'.

4.3.97.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his object of veneration' after the word महाराज।

4.3.98.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his object of veneration' after the words 1. वासुदेव and अर्जुना।

4.3.99.v: The affix वुञ् comes diversely in the sense of 'this is his object of veneration' after a word denoting गोत्र (Patronymic) or a क्षत्रिय।

4.3.100.v: Of words denoting Princes (literally - who are Lords of जनपद) the base and affix meaning 'this is his object of veneration' are the same, in every respect, like those of a word denoting kingdom, provided that, the Prince-denoting words have, in the plural, the same form as the Kingdom-denoting words.

4.3.101.v: After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, an affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc., comes in the sense of 'enounced by him'.

4.3.102.v: The affix छण् comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. तित्तिरि 2. वरतन्तु 3. खण्डिक and 4. उख।

4.3.103.v: The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. काश्यप and 2. कौशिक denoting ऋषि-s (Vedic Seers).

4.3.104.v: After the words denoting the pupils of कलापि and वैशम्पायन , the affix णिनि is used in the sense of 'enounced by him'.

4.3.105.v: The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction when it denotes a ब्राह्मण or a कल्प-work enounced by ancient sages.

4.3.106.v: The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words शौनक etc. in denoting छन्दस् (Vedas).

4.3.107.v: The affix denoting 'enounced by him' is elided by लुक्-substitution after the words कठ and चरक।

4.3.108.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the word कलापि।

4.3.109.v: The affix ढिनुक् comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the word छगलिन।

4.3.110.v: The affix णिनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. पाराशर्य and 2. शिलालिन् , the works enounced being भिक्षु-sūtra and नट-sūtra respectively.

4.3.111.v: The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' the thing enounced being भिक्षु-sūtra and नट-sūtra after the words 1. कर्मन्द 2. कृशाश्व।

4.3.112.v: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc. comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'in the same direction with that'.

4.3.113.v: The affix तसि comes in the sense of 'in the same direction with that'.

4.3.114.v: The affixes यत् and तसि come in the sense of 'in the same direction with that' after the word उरस।

4.3.115.v: After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction an affix is used in the sense 'discovered by him'.

4.3.116.v: An affix comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'made', the thing made being 'a book'.

4.3.117.v: An affix comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'made by him' when the whole word is a Name.

4.3.118.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'made by him' after the words कुलाल etc. the whole word so formed being a Name.

4.3.119.v: The affix अञ् comes after the words 1. क्षुद्रा 2. भ्रमर 3. वटर and 4. पादप in the sense of 'made by him', the whole word being a Name.

4.3.120.v: After a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] comes in the sense of 'this is his',

4.3.121.v: The affix यत् comes after रथ in the sense of 'this is his'.

4.3.122.v: When preceded by a word denoting 'a draught animal', रथ takes the affix अञ् in the sense of 'this is his'.

4.3.123.v: After a word denoting a draught-animal and after the words 1. अध्वर्यु and 2. परिषद् the affix अञ् is added.

4.3.124.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words 1. हल and 2. सीर।

4.3.125.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after द्वन्द compound of words denoting 'mutual enmity' or 'matrimonial relationship'.

4.3.126.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words denoting गोत्र (Patronymic/Family-names) of Vedic schools.

4.3.127.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after a गोत्र (Patronymic) word ending with the affix अञ् or यञ् or इञ् , the words so formed expressing a multitude, a mark or a sign.

4.3.128.v: The affix अण् optionally comes in the sense of 'this is his congregation, mark, sign or hamlet' after the word शाकल।

4.3.129.v: The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'this is his Law or Tradition' after the words 1. छान्दोग 2. औक्थिक 3. याज्ञिक 4. बह्वृच and 5. नट।

4.3.130.v: The affix वुञ् is not used after a Family-name when it denotes 'a beginner pupil' and 'a boarder pupil'.

4.3.131.v: The affix छ comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words रैवतिक etc.

4.3.132.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words 1. कौपिञ्जल 2. हास्तिपद।

4.3.133.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the word आथर्वणिक and the penultimate इक् is elided.

4.3.134.v: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc., comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'a modification thereof'.

4.3.135.v: An affix comes after a word denoting an animal, a herb and a tree in Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense 'this is its part' (as well as 'this is its modification').

4.3.136.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its modification or its part' after the words बिल्व etc.

4.3.137.v: After a word having क् as its penultimate, the affix अण् comes in the sense of modification or a part or both, as appropriate.

4.3.138.v: The affix अण् with the augment षुक् comes in the sense of 'its modification' after the words त्रपुन् and जतुन्।

4.3.139.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' (provided that the word has not the अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable).

4.3.140.v: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after a word having अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable.

4.3.141.v: The affix अञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'modification or part' after the words पलाश etc.

4.3.142.v: The affix ट्लञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after the word शमी।

4.3.143.v: The affix मयट् comes optionally after any base, in these two meanings of 'product' and 'part' in secular language when neither food nor clothing is spoken of.

4.3.144.v: The affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product' and 'part' when neither food nor clothing is spoken of, invariably after वृद्ध words and शर etc.

4.3.145.v: The affix मयट् comes after the word गो in the sense of 'its dung'.

4.3.146.v: The affix मयट् invariably comes in the sense of 'its product or part' after the word पिष्ट।

4.3.147.v: The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'product' after the word पिष्ट , the whole word being a Name.

4.3.148.v: The affix मयट् comes after the word व्रीहि in the sense of a पुरोडाश।

4.3.149.v: The affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product' after the words तिल and यवा - the whole not being a name.

4.3.150.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a disyllabic word the affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product or part'.

4.3.151.v: The affix मयट् does not come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the disyllabic words having a short vowel उ in them, nor after the words 1. वर्ध्र and 2. बिल्वा।

4.3.152.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its product or part' after the words ताला etc.

4.3.153.v: The affix अण् comes after a word denoting 'gold' when the sense is a weight or measure.

4.3.154.v: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the words expressing living beings and after रजत etc.

4.3.155.v: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after a word which ends in an affix having an indicatory ञ् , such affix denoting 'its product or part'.

4.3.156.v: After a word denoting 'a measure' the affix expressing 'its product or part' is the same as the affix having the sense of 'purchased'.

4.3.157.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the word उष्ट्र।

4.3.158.v: The affix वुञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'product or part' after the words 1. उमा and 2. ऊर्णा।

4.3.159.v: The affix ढञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'product or part' after the feminine word एणी।

4.3.160.v: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the words 1. गो and 2. पयस्।

4.3.161.v: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the word द्रु।

4.3.162.v: The affix वय comes in the sense of 'product' after the word द्रु , the word meaning 'a measure'.

4.3.163.v: The affix denoting 'product or part' is लुक् elided when such a product or part is 'a fruit'.

4.3.164.v: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'product or part, it being a fruit' after the words प्लक्ष etc.

4.3.165.v: The affix अण् optionally comes in denoting a fruit after the word जम्बु।

4.3.166.v: The affix denoting 'fruit' is optionally elided by लुप् after the word जम्बु।

4.3.167.v: The affix denoting 'fruit' is elided by लुप् after the words हरीतकी etc.

4.3.168.v: The affixes यञ् and अञ् come respectively in the sense of 'its product' after the words 1. कंसीय and 2. परशव्य and there is लुक् elision (of the छ and यत् affixes of those words).
